desc: Endless Glitz Pit played for real on a finished file (the auto-battler with god mode, scenes skipped): four rounds won one after another, each under the major league's "no items" condition (TTYD_MODERUN_PIT_RULE=5: the auto-battler uses none, so the run isn't lost to a random condition), the enemies' scaling rising each round (130% HP at round 4); then, once round 4 is won, Leave as the Settings tab's button does (TTYD_MODERUN_PIT_ROUNDS=4): the Pit's scaling off, Mario back in Rogueport where he stood, control back with nothing lent; the file's partners, badges, key items and story as they were (its coins grew by the rounds' winnings; Mario's level may have risen: the Pit's battles are his own) (the eleven-round run with Crowd Favorite: moderun_pit_long)
log_must: \[modes\] pit round 4: enemies at 130% HP, 115% attack
\[moderun\] Endless Glitz Pit: leave asked \(in the field\)
\[modes\] endless pit stopped at step 5: back to gor_01
